title: eludite.forge.pulls input
description: List the repository's pull requests (the Pull Requests window; merge requests on GitLab): `filter` `mine` (authored by the signed-in account), `review_requested` (a review is asked of it) or `all`, `state` (default `open`) and `text` (in the title and description), paged. Answers from the cache on disk at once (`stale: true` and its age) while a refresh runs off-thread; a failed refresh keeps the cache and says why (`refresh_error`). Read. The repository is the workspace's (its remote `origin`, or `remote`), detected as eludite.forge.detect does; every call runs on the forge worker off the UI thread with a timeout and stops when canceled. A call that needs a token when none is stored for the host fails with `sign_in_required: <host>`: the person signs in (Git > Sign in to <forge>); an agent cannot.

max.description: Items per page: default 50, at most 200.

refresh.description: Wait for a fresh answer from the forge instead of answering from the cache at once.

remote.description: The git remote to read (default `origin`, else the only remote).
